.. change::
    :tags: documentation, typing
    :tickets: 13357

    Clarified that a plain Python sequence passed to :func:`_sql.any_` or
    :func:`_sql.all_` may be wrapped in :func:`_sql.literal` when a backend's
    DBAPI supports adapting the sequence as a single array parameter.  This
    keeps the SQL expression explicit and type-checkable without promising
    sequence adaptation on drivers that do not provide it.
